summary: Studio City International Holdings Limited (NYSE: MSC) filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 23, 2026, announcing that independent director Dominique Mielle was appointed chairperson of the audit and risk committee effective immediately. Mielle, already chair of the nominating and corporate governance committee and a member of the audit and risk and compensation committees, was also designated an audit committee financial expert under Item 16A of Form 20-F. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, regulatory clock, or deal terms are involved. The event is a routine committee appointment, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
